script_text: Stop scrolling, Pisces — the stars are quietly rewriting your bank account this week. In love, Venus in Libra illuminates your 8th House of Intimacy: expect someone to confess feelings or propose merging finances — take neither lightly. Career-wise, lucky Jupiter in your 6th House of Daily Work forms a sextile to Venus — a raise or freelance windfall lands before Friday. Warning: don't lend money today. Follow now — Friday's Full Moon reading reveals what Saturn's been hiding.
